summary: Full 16-step Memory Archive V3 flow tested end-to-end on desktop 1920x900 and confession sub-flow on mobile 390x844. All stages render, all data-testids resolve, whileInView animations fire once elements are scrolled into view via scroll_into_view_if_needed, confession Typewriter completes, transition-missing and transition-lost auto-advance, Score counters animate, QuietStage auto-advances, ApologyStage staggered lines and cta appear, UnlockStage shows correct status/closer, restart works. Moving NO button verified on both stage-chapter-03 and stage-final: bounding box stays fully inside dashed containment zone and never intersects YES button after multiple hover dodges. Share flow: POST /api/archive -> 200 with archive id, /a/{id} URL loads the full experience. Typography: body = 'DM Sans, sans-serif', headings = 'Cormorant Garamond, serif'. Mobile: document.scrollWidth == 390 (no horizontal overflow) before and after navigation to chapter 01.

issues: Chapter marker (CH 01 / 04) at top-5/left-6 can visually overlap the tail of a scrolled line since stage is scrollable behind the fixed marker. Minor — expected given fixed marker over scroll region.

critical_code_review_comments: MovingNoButton: no-quip requires tries>=3 but a hover that lands on a moved-away element may miss dodge; consider incrementing tries on pointermove near button too. Non-blocking.
ShareButton silently swallows POST failures (catch(_)) — surfaces no user feedback on error. Consider a toast/error state.
Experience.jsx uses window.scrollTo on step change but stages are `fixed` with their own overflow-y-auto; window scroll is a no-op. Not harmful but dead code.
seed_data_creation: One archive created via POST /api/archive during share regression: id=9669c561-ec05-4c54-81c9-8c6064eebf81
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fixed-position stages with internal overflow-y-auto require element.scroll_into_view_if_needed() to trigger framer-motion whileInView (window.scrollTo is a no-op). ArchiveTransitions (missing/lost) auto-advance after typewriter + 1.4s delay — wait up to 10s. QuietStage auto-advances after 3.2s. ApologyStage cta appears ~4-5s after mount due to staggered whileInView delays. NO button dodges on mouseenter; use force click on yes-button to proceed. All flow works cleanly.
